From 91edf63d5022bd0464788ffb4acc3d5febbaf81d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Bryan O'Donoghue <bryan.odonoghue@linaro.org>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2020 08:49:18 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] usb: chipidea: msm: Ensure proper controller reset using role
 switch API

Currently we check to make sure there is no error state on the extcon
handle for VBUS when writing to the HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2 register. When using
the USB role-switch API we still need to write to this register absent an
extcon handle.

This patch makes the appropriate update to ensure the write happens if
role-switching is true.

Fixes: 05559f10ed79 ("usb: chipidea: add role switch class support")
Cc: stable <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Cc: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>
Cc: Philipp Zabel <p.zabel@pengutronix.de>
Cc: linux-usb@vger.kernel.org
Cc: linux-kernel@vger.kernel.org
Cc: Stephen Boyd <swboyd@chromium.org>
Signed-off-by: Bryan O'Donoghue <bryan.odonoghue@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Peter Chen <peter.chen@nxp.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200507004918.25975-2-peter.chen@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/usb/chipidea/ci_hdrc_msm.c b/drivers/usb/chipidea/ci_hdrc_msm.c
index af648ba6544d..46105457e1ca 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/chipidea/ci_hdrc_msm.c
+++ b/drivers/usb/chipidea/ci_hdrc_msm.c
@@ -114,7 +114,7 @@ static int ci_hdrc_msm_notify_event(struct ci_hdrc *ci, unsigned event)
 			hw_write_id_reg(ci, HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2,
 					HS_PHY_ULPI_TX_PKT_EN_CLR_FIX, 0);
 
-		if (!IS_ERR(ci->platdata->vbus_extcon.edev)) {
+		if (!IS_ERR(ci->platdata->vbus_extcon.edev) || ci->role_switch) {
 			hw_write_id_reg(ci, HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2,
 					HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN,
 					HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/usb/chipidea/ci_hdrc_msm.c`**
- The conditional check for writing to the `HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2` register has been modified. 
- The original condition checked if the `vbus_extcon.edev` was not an error (`!IS_ERR(ci->platdata->vbus_extcon.edev)`).
- The modified condition now also checks if `ci->role_switch` is true, allowing the write to occur even when there is no extcon handle, thus ensuring proper controller reset when using the role-switch API.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug related to the USB role-switch API by ensuring that the necessary register write occurs regardless of the extcon handle's state, as long as role-switching is enabled. This change is directly linked to the previous implementation that added role switch class support, which was identified as the source of the issue. The patch aims to enhance the functionality and reliability of the USB controller's reset mechanism in scenarios where role-switching is utilized.

You will be given details about a bug, including:
1. The root cause.
2. Code statements that lead to the bug and the reason for it.
3. Code statements that fix the bug and the reason for the fix.

Root cause:
The bug arises from the failure to write to the `HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2` register when using the USB role-switch API, specifically when there is no extcon handle available. The original implementation only allowed the write operation if the extcon handle was valid, which did not account for scenarios where role-switching was enabled, leading to improper controller reset behavior.

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (!IS_ERR(ci->platdata->vbus_extcon.edev)) {
    hw_write_id_reg(ci, HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2,
                    HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN,
                    HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN);
}
```
Reason:
The original implementation only allowed writing to the `HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2` register if the `vbus_extcon` handle was valid (i.e., not an error). This check did not account for scenarios where role-switching was enabled, leading to a failure to write to the register and resulting in improper controller reset behavior.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (!IS_ERR(ci->platdata->vbus_extcon.edev) || ci->role_switch) {
    hw_write_id_reg(ci, HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2,
                    HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN,
                    HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN);
}
```
Reason:
The patch modifies the condition to allow writing to the `HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2` register not only when the `vbus_extcon` handle is valid but also when role-switching is enabled (`ci->role_switch`). This ensures that the write operation occurs correctly during role-switching, thus fixing the improper controller reset behavior.
